note: Per-film OKLab statistics measured from film frames. Derived numbers only: no imagery is stored, redistributed or linked here. film-grab.com stills were fetched once at ~1 req/s under a self-identifying user agent, measured, and deleted; only these aggregates survive.

measures.glare: median frame OKLab L50 - overall level, murk <-> glare
measures.hardness: IQR of frame L50 - frame-to-frame luminance contrast
measures.chroma90: median frame C90 - saturation of the most colourful areas
measures.warmth: median chroma-weighted projection on the amber<->teal axis
measures.warmspread: IQR of frame warmth - how far the palette travels

sources.film-grab: curator-selected stills, 32 frames requested per film; the truer instrument and the calibration reference
sources.tmdb: promotional backdrops, up to 8 per film; systematically brighter, so calibrated onto the film-grab scale

calibration.direction: offset added to the TMDB side (film-grab is the reference)

fameFlatness.worst_axis_note: worst |rho| across the seven measures vs 60-day en.wikipedia pageviews

bwAnchor.note: chroma < 0.002 counted as monochrome; residual outliers are tinted/toned prints and part-colour films Wikidata tags black-and-white, not measurement error

caveat: film-grab coverage carries a steep fame gradient (9.7% of the quietest pageview quartile, 76.1% of the loudest), so this file has a PRECISION gradient favouring the canon: famous films get 32-frame measurements, quiet films 8-frame ones, and much of the corpus none. Never compare these numbers without carrying source and n alongside them.
